task_requirements.objective: Glycan-aware interface refinement benchmark task: refine/design BDBV-43-derived antibody interface against Gal-3BP (LGALS3BP, UniProt Q08380) following the published study's workflow shape (ref complex -> CDR redesign -> matched evaluation -> interface sampling), using verifiable public inputs
constraints: Study full text (DOI 10.1016/j.compbiomed.2026.111550) unobtainable from this host: repositorio.usp.br TCP 443 blocked, ScienceDirect headless-blocked, no open copy. All study-specific inputs are NEEDS_INPUT; this is NOT a matched reproduction
Public inputs used instead: BDBV-43 Fv from PDB 7KEW; Gal-3BP mature chain (res 19-585) from UniProt Q08380 + AlphaFold AF-Q08380 model v6
Reference complex is a computational assembly (AF2-Multimer prediction), NOT an experimentally determined complex
Interface definition everywhere: antibody-antigen residue pair with CA-CA distance < 6 A

workflow_plan.W4_interface_sampling: cross-model interface RMSD + contact persistence on 5 AFM ref models; local Protenix 3 seeds x 5 samples as independent-protocol evidence
